exact_missing_items: These three states are not synonyms and must not be conflated in any doc
Acknowledgement model: 'acknowledged' ≠ 'resolved' ≠ 'dismissed'; acknowledgement is for advisory/non-blocking concerns only; blockers are not acknowledgeable
Settings groupings must be: Providers & Models, Execution Identity, Governance, Workers, Recovery, HITL — these are the canonical top-level settings categories
GUI help/tooltip generation requires: stable canonical terminology, clear object vs state vs action distinctions, and enough 'why this exists' language to support Simple/Expert/ELI5 derivation
Alert surface split: Dashboard shows summary/urgency only; Orchestrator shows detailed operational alerts; chat shows only Action Required alerts

The same concern model must be projected per surface: Progress=operational, Seams=integration/governance, Evidence=proof-backed, History=lifecycle timeline, Ledger=structured record; no surface invents its own concern shape

Direct-record views (promotion record, graph patch record + state transition report, recovery/restore record, concern record) must each show: currentness, generation match, superseded flag, actionable state
dismissed should suppress concern presentation but not canonical blocked episodes if those remain active
